mapping: iNES PRG starts at 0x0010; fixed bank $1F maps CPU $E000-$FFFF.
scope: The fresh field-entry descriptor-$00 call at `$E0DF`, descriptor-$01 call at `$E0E4`, fixed-bank field setup from `$E0E9` through `$E349`, and bank-$1C `$8024->$82CA` minimap source; asynchronous renderer workers, NMI, and PPU output remain separate source effects.

spans.description: ROM code: LDA #$00 selects descriptor $00, then JSR $EF7F enters the fixed renderer wrapper.
ROM code: after descriptor $00 returns, LDA #$01 selects descriptor $01 and JSR $EF7F enters the second renderer call.
Fixed-bank ROM source from the post-render `$E233` field-setup call through the `$E349` input-loop entry.
ROM jump vector selected by fixed-bank `$E247 JSR $8024`; routes to minimap loader `$82CA`.
ROM code for the 12-row minimap setup, including `$C52D` wait helper, `$04A5` packet builder calls, `$0515` buffer handshake, and the `$834A` tile-table pointer.
ROM tile-ID table read by the minimap row producer: 12 rows × 24 tiles, before full-pitch drawing replaces the lower-screen area.

limitations: The packaged fixed-bank span ends at `$E349`, at field-loop input entry; it does not model the complete field loop, NMI cadence, or PPU output.
The minimap's cooperative row execution and PPU/NMI transfer still require a connected runtime path.
Emulator traces are comparison evidence only; runtime executes the extracted ROM bytes and decoded fixed wrapper.
